title: Intel D270 GPU AI Accelerator–Up to 480 GB LPDDR5X
hook_text: Intel packed 480 gigabytes into a new GPU
script:
Intel built the new D270 discrete GPU accelerator for data center workloads.
It features the Xe3P architecture, previously codenamed Crescent Island.
The hardware delivers massive capacity with up to 480 GB of LPDDR5X memory.
Enterprise data centers rely on this memory size to power large AI models efficiently.
Unlike consumer graphics cards, this accelerator skips traditional 3D display outputs entirely.
Intel designed it specifically for heavy server demands instead of gaming setups.
Will your next enterprise cluster run on this new processor?
